description:
The scheduler's configuration and current status (free; any proven patron).

Relays the cron Worker's public ``/status`` — cadence, version, renewal
window, and current authorization phase (``pending`` / ``active`` / ``idle``,
no challenge phrase) — and adds the operator npub it acts for. No secrets:
the pending phrase (operator-only) is ``scheduler_pending``; the per-tick
traffic log is ``get_scheduler_log``. Returns the merged config, or
``{worker: "unavailable"}`` merged in if the Worker can't be reached.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

name: excalibur_scheduler_status
title: Scheduler status
